summary: Per 10 ms on the Workers Paid bill: CPU only while working, memory and disk for as long as the instance runs.
lostNote: A stopped instance loses its disk; files have to be backed up to R2 or a snapshot and restored.

egress.note: $0.025 per GB in North America and Europe beyond the 1 TB included; $0.04–$0.05 per GB elsewhere, with 500 GB included. Outbound traffic is off unless turned on.
egress.included: 1 TB a month in North America and Europe

notes: Workers, Durable Objects and R2 usage are billed separately.
Egress is $0.025 per GB in North America and Europe beyond the 1 TB included each month.
Disk sizes, the disk rate and the 200 GB-hour allowance are in decimal GB; they are converted to GiB here (20 GB is about 18.63 GiB).
